# chainlaunch_install_ssh (Resource)

Manages Chainlaunch installation as a systemd service on a remote Linux machine via SSH



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host` (String) SSH host address (IP or hostname)
- `user` (String) SSH username

### Optional

- `auto_start` (Boolean) Enable service auto-start on boot (default: true)
- `data_path` (String) Data directory for Chainlaunch (default: /var/lib/chainlaunch)
- `environment` (Map of String) Environment variables for Chainlaunch service
- `install_path` (String) Installation directory (default: /opt/chainlaunch)
- `password` (String, Sensitive) SSH password (use private_key instead for better security)
- `port` (Number) SSH port (default: 22)
- `port_8100` (Number) Chainlaunch API port (default: 8100)
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) SSH private key content (PEM format)
- `version` (String) Chainlaunch version to install (default: latest)

### Read-Only

- `chainlaunch_url` (String) URL to access Chainlaunch (http://host:port_8100)
- `id` (String) Resource identifier (host:port)
- `installed_version` (String) Currently installed Chainlaunch version
- `service_status` (String) Current systemd service status
